evals.name: aws-vpc-complete-suite
evals.prompt: Generate Terraform tests for my AWS module. The code is in ./test-modules/eval-1-aws-vpc/. Use standard security best practices for compliance. No tfvars file - use sensible defaults. Include both unit tests (using mock providers with command = plan) and integration tests (using command = apply for real infrastructure validation).
evals.expected_output: A complete test suite covering unit, integration, mock, validation, and compliance tests, with COVERAGE.md and README.md. Data sources (aws_availability_zones, aws_ami) must be mocked with override_data. Must avoid the documented anti-patterns: no [0] on set-types, no .id/.arn assertions under command = plan, no multi-line assert conditions, no terraform test -filter with wildcards.
expectations: data.aws_availability_zones.available is mocked with override_data in unit/mock tests (not mock_data inside mock_provider)
data.aws_ami.al2023 is mocked with override_data in unit/mock tests (not mock_data inside mock_provider)
Every run block in unit_*.tftest.hcl includes providers = { aws = aws.mock }
No assertion under command = plan references a computed attribute (.id, .arn, .self_link)
No [0] indexing on set-type attributes (security_group ingress/egress accessed via for expressions instead)
All assert condition expressions are on a single line
Naming variables are transformed to test-safe values (environment = "test", names carry a test- prefix)
All required module variables are set in every run block
Validation tests use expect_failures targeted at the specific variable for each invalid input
Compliance tests contain non-trivial conditions (not condition = true) covering at least two of: encryption, tagging, network security
Integration test files contain at least one command = apply run block (command = plan permitted only for an idempotency-verification run)
Test files follow the documented naming pattern: unit_*.tftest.hcl, integration_*.tftest.hcl, mock_*.tftest.hcl, validation_*.tftest.hcl, compliance_*.tftest.hcl
README.md does not invoke terraform test -filter with a wildcard pattern
README.md documents both terraform test and tofu test command equivalents
README.md states that test files belong in a tests/ directory and includes integration-cost/safety warnings
COVERAGE.md is produced with a per-test-type summary table
